title: Stable Isotopes- Adults With Obesity
official: Assessing Metabolic Health With Stable Isotope Tracer Techniques in Adults With Obesity
summary: In a crossover design, 8 participants will receive caloric drinks containing stable isotopes. In one arm of the study, participants will consume 6 hourly drinks containing two stable isotopes. Repeated blood, breath, urine, and muscle biopsies will be taken. In the second arm, participants will consume 1 drink containing 75g glucose, labeled with two stable isotopes of glucose. Periodic blood and breath will be taken over three hours.

interventions.name: Stable Isotope Oral Glucose Tolerance Test

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ages 19-59
* Obese \>/= 30 kg/m\^2 and \>/= 102 cm for males and \>/= 88 cm for females
* Godin Leisure-time or exercise questionnaire \<14 units

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Pregnant or become pregnant
2. Any known food allergies
3. Smoker
4. Are physically active
5. Have any known metabolic diseases
6. Have been weight unstable within the last 6 months (lost or gained \>10% of body mass)
7. Non eumenorrheic or on a hormonal birth control
